channel.title: Neural Critic
channel.description: Gaming news, reviews, guides, and features for players who want the signal—not the noise.

item.title: GTA 6 DualSense Controller Preorders: Price, Release Date and Where to Buy
item.description: GTA 6 DualSense preorders open September 10. Here are the black and white controller prices, release date, retailer availability and buying details.

item.title: PS5 State of Play September 2026: GTA 6, FF7 Revelation and Every Announcement
item.description: Every major announcement from PlayStation’s September 2026 State of Play, including GTA 6 controllers, FF7 Revelation, Until Dawn 2, Metro 2039 and more.

item.title: Final Fantasy VII Revelation Release Date, Platforms, Editions and Early Access
item.description: Final Fantasy VII Revelation launches April 8, 2027. Here are the confirmed platforms, editions, preorder bonuses and 24-hour early-access details.

item.title: Metro 2039 Release Date Confirmed, PS5 and Xbox 60fps Ray Tracing Detailed
item.description: Metro 2039 launches February 4, 2027. Here are the confirmed platforms, PS5 Pro details and 60fps ray-traced performance options on console.

item.title: Until Dawn 2 Release Date, Preorders and Digital Deluxe Edition Explained
item.description: Until Dawn 2 launches January 28, 2027 on PS5. Here are the preorder date, Digital Deluxe Edition details and key State of Play reveals.

item.title: LEGO PlayStation Price, Release Date and 1,911-Piece Set Details
item.description: The 1,911-piece LEGO PlayStation recreates Sony’s original console and controller. Here are the price, October release dates and availability details.

item.title: Intergalactic: The Heretic Prophet Wraps ‘Very Ambitious’ Cinematic Shoot
item.description: Naughty Dog has wrapped Intergalactic’s cinematic shoot, marking a major PS5 development milestone. A September 3 State of Play is confirmed, but the game is not.

item.title: EXODUS Gameplay Deep Dive Reveals Salt, Combat and a Time-Dilated Sci-Fi RPG
item.description: Game Informer’s new EXODUS deep dive follows a four-hour hands-on session at Archetype Entertainment, revealing more about Salt, combat, the Awakened and the RPG’s time-dilation story.

item.title: Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis Gameplay Reimagines Peru, Puzzles and the T-Rex
item.description: An extended gamescom 2026 gameplay presentation for Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis shows Lara exploring Peru, solving rebuilt puzzles and facing raptors and a reimagined T-Rex.

item.title: Fable’s 18-Minute Gameplay Shows Bowerstone, Property Ownership and Choice
item.description: Playground Games has released 18 minutes of Fable gameplay from gamescom 2026, showing a quest through Bowerstone, property ownership, choice and consequence, and combat.

item.title: The Witcher 3: Songs of the Past Gameplay Shows Letten and Geralt’s New Chain
item.description: New Songs of the Past gameplay takes Geralt through Letten, shows an early quest, and demonstrates the Witcher 3 expansion’s new silver chain combat.

item.title: Mario Kart 8 Deluxe: Best Kart Builds and What the Stats Actually Mean
item.description: A practical breakdown of speed, acceleration, mini-turbo, handling, weight, and strong kart combinations for different Mario Kart 8 Deluxe playstyles.

item.title: Baldur’s Gate 3 Beginner’s Guide: Classes, Combat and Exploration Explained
item.description: A clear introduction to classes, ability checks, turn-based combat, companions, rests, exploration, and the choices new Baldur’s Gate 3 players face early on.

item.title: Tears of the Kingdom Beginner’s Guide: Essential Tips for Exploring Hyrule
item.description: A spoiler-light introduction to Ultrahand, Fuse, Ascend, Recall, exploration, resources, and the systems that define Tears of the Kingdom.

item.title: Breath of the Wild Beginner’s Guide: What to Do First in Hyrule
item.description: The essential things new players should understand about exploration, shrines, weapons, cooking, stamina, and surviving Hyrule’s opening hours.

item.title: Elden Ring Beginner’s Guide: What to Know Before Entering the Lands Between
item.description: A practical starting guide to exploration, combat, leveling, equipment, Sites of Grace, and the early decisions that make Elden Ring easier to understand.

item.title: Which Game Has Won the Most GOTY Awards? The Most-Awarded Games Explained
item.description: Which games have won the most Game of the Year awards? Neural Critic breaks down the modern GOTY record, why award totals vary by tracker, and the games that dominate the all-time conversation.

item.title: GTA 6 Extended Look: Everything Rockstar Revealed About Vice City, Jason and Lucia
item.description: Rockstar’s first extended look at Grand Theft Auto VI puts the scale and detail of Leonida front and center, while revealing more about Jason and Lucia, missions, nightlife, activities and the systems shaping Vice City.

item.title: Elden Ring: Tarnished Edition Hits 91 on Metacritic After Switch 2 Performance Fears
item.description: Elden Ring: Tarnished Edition is now available on Nintendo Switch 2, and final reviews suggest FromSoftware has turned a worrying early port into a surprisingly strong handheld version of the Lands Between.

item.title: Future Games Show at gamescom 2026 Delivers 13 World Premieres and a Packed Slate of Release Updates
item.description: The Future Games Show at gamescom 2026 featured 13 world-premiere trailers alongside new gameplay, demos, and release updates for dozens of upcoming games.

item.title: Crazy Taxi: World Tour Reveals Germany Map, New Crazy Drift Move and September Network Test
item.description: Sega has shown the Germany map for Crazy Taxi: World Tour at gamescom 2026, alongside new driving mechanics and a multiplayer closed network test scheduled for September.

item.title: Persona 4 Revival Gamescom Demo Reveals Modernized Dungeons and a New Prime Time Meter
item.description: Sega and P-Studio have detailed Persona 4 Revival’s first public playable demo at gamescom 2026, including three demo channels, modernized dungeons, and the new Prime Time combat meter.

item.title: Baldur’s Gate 3 Review: A New Standard for RPG Freedom
item.description: Larian’s role-playing epic turns player choice, flexible problem solving, and memorable companions into one of the most reactive adventures in modern RPGs.

item.title: The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom Review: A Brilliant Sequel Built on Possibility
item.description: Tears of the Kingdom expands Breath of the Wild’s freedom with creative building systems, layered exploration, and a Hyrule designed around player invention.

item.title: Red Dead Redemption 2 Review: An Unforgettable Western Epic
item.description: Rockstar’s vast western pairs extraordinary world detail and character writing with a deliberately paced journey through the final days of an outlaw gang.

item.title: Super Mario Odyssey Review: Nintendo’s 3D Platforming Playground
item.description: Super Mario Odyssey turns movement, possession, and discovery into a joyful globe-trotting platformer packed with playful ideas.

item.title: Mario Kart 8 Deluxe Review: The Definitive Kart Racer
item.description: Years of additions have turned Mario Kart 8 Deluxe into an enormous, polished celebration of Nintendo’s accessible but surprisingly deep racing formula.

item.title: The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild Review: Freedom Redefined
item.description: Nintendo’s open-air Zelda reinvention remains a landmark adventure built around curiosity, experimentation, and the freedom to make Hyrule your own.

item.title: Cyberpunk 2077 Beginner’s Guide: What New Players Should Know
item.description: A modern starting guide to builds, perks, cyberware, weapons, gigs, exploration, and the systems that matter most when beginning a new life in Night City.

item.title: 2026 Game of the Year Watchlist: The 10 Games Leading the Race So Far
item.description: Neural Critic’s living 2026 Game of the Year watchlist tracks the strongest games released so far and the titles currently making the best case for year-end recognition.
